book_name: 全新版大学进阶英语综合教程2

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.ex: The city-dweller loves the noise and lights of downtown.
words.ex_cn: 城市居民喜欢市中心的喧嚣和灯光。
words.en: A person who lives in a city.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He wants to be self-sufficient by growing his own food.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过自己种食物来实现自给自足。
words.en: A self-sufficient person or thing is able to provide for themselves without outside assistance.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: I just learned of the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚得知明天的会议。
words.en: To become aware of something, typically by being told about it.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

words.tr: n. 效用；实用；公用事业；
words.ex: The utility of this tool is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的效用非常高。
words.en: Utility refers to the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.

words.tr:
v. 拖；拉；拖运；
n. 拖；拉；拖运；
words.ex: He hauled the heavy box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他把沉重的箱子拖过了房间。
words.en: To haul something means to pull it or carry it with a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 放进；插入；提出；提交；使就职；进港
words.ex: Put in the keys before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前把钥匙放进去。
words.en: To place something inside or into a particular position or location.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.tr: phrase. 详情；来龙去脉；复杂细节；曲折内情
words.ex: He knows all the ins and outs of the company's operations.
words.ex_cn: 他熟知公司运营的所有复杂细节。
words.en: The ins and outs of a situation are all the detailed points and facts about it.

words.tr: phrase. 某事的全部细节；来龙去脉；错综复杂的情况
words.ex: He knows all the ins and outs of the legal system.
words.ex_cn: 他了解法律系统的所有细节。
words.en: The detailed facts or features of something.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He made an adjustment to live in the new city.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了适应以适应新城市的生活。
words.en: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. 认为某人理所当然；把某人视为理所当然而不珍惜
words.ex: She felt hurt because her friends took her for granted.
words.ex_cn: 她感到受伤，因为她的朋友们认为她理所当然。
words.en: If you take someone or something for granted, you do not appreciate them or it enough because you think they will always be there or it will always happen or be available.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: This tool is in use right now.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具现在正在使用中。
words.en: Currently being used or occupied.

words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很勤奋地做作业。
words.en: Someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: He tosses the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To throw something, especially something light, with a quick, light motion.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.tr: adj. 随心所欲的；自由放纵的
words.ex: He has a free-wheeling approach to life, always doing what he wants.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活采取了一种随心所欲的态度，总是做他想做的事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as free-wheeling, you mean they behave in a casual, relaxed way without worrying about rules or the consequences of their actions.

words.tr: phrase. 更进一步；走得更远
words.ex: The company decided to go further in expanding its market overseas.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定进一步拓展海外市场。
words.en: To extend or advance beyond a certain point or limit.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 为…做准备；为…做好准备；以备
words.ex: He is studying hard in preparation for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，为考试做准备。
words.en: In preparation for is used to indicate that something is being done to get ready for a future event or situation.

words.ex: Align your goals with your actions.
words.ex_cn: 让你的目标与行动保持一致。
words.en: To arrange something in a straight line or in the correct position in relation to something else, usually so that it is parallel to it.

words.ex: The city plans for sustainability by using solar energy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市通过使用太阳能来实现可持续性。
words.en: Sustainability is the ability to maintain or support a process continuously over time. In the context of environmental science, it refers to the avoidance of the depletion of natural resources in order to maintain an ecological balance.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.tr: phrase. 装载；装满；把（货物、弹药、程序等）装入；使大量摄入（食物、饮料、药物等）
words.ex: He likes to load up on snacks before the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在看电影前买很多零食。
words.en: To fill or pack something with a large amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 达成一笔交易；成功售出
words.ex: He will make a sale tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会做成一笔销售。
words.en: To successfully sell a product or service.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.tr: adj. 装有发动机的； v. “motorize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The motorized bike goes faster than a regular one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆装有发动机的自行车比普通自行车更快。
words.en: Equipped with a motor or motors, especially for propulsion.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr: adj. 断断续续的；间歇的
words.ex: The rain is intermittent today.
words.ex_cn: 今天雨断断续续地下。
words.en: Something that is intermittent happens occasionally rather than continuously.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.ex: There are 5 apples and 3 oranges, in total 8 fruits.
words.ex_cn: 有5个苹果和3个橙子，总共8个水果。
words.en: as a whole; including everything or everyone

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: They carpool to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天一起拼车上班。
words.en: A carpool is an arrangement where a group of people take turns driving each other to work, school, etc., in order to save money and reduce the number of vehicles on the road.

words.tr:
adj. 学龄前的；入学前的；
n. 幼儿园；幼稚园；
words.ex: He attends a preschool program every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上参加学龄前课程。
words.en: A school for children who are too young to attend kindergarten, typically for those aged between three and five.

words.ex: The king suffered from treachery by his own friend.
words.ex_cn: 国王被自己朋友背叛了。
words.en: Treachery is behavior that involves betraying someone's trust or being disloyal.

words.ex: He passed the test, albeit with a low score.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，尽管分数很低。
words.en: You use albeit to introduce a fact or comment which reduces the force or significance of what you have just said.

words.ex: The storm left debris on the road.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在道路上留下了碎片。
words.en: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.tr:
v. 牵引；拖
n. 牵引；拖
words.ex: He tows his broken car to the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把坏掉的车拖到修理厂。
words.en: To pull a vehicle or boat along behind another vehicle, using a rope or chain.

words.tr: n. 一种附加在成人自行车后部的儿童自行车，使儿童可以跟随成人骑行。
words.ex: The family went for a bike ride with their child on a trail-a-bike.
words.ex_cn: 这家人带着他们的孩子在一种trail-a-bike上骑自行车。
words.en: A type of child's bicycle that can be attached to the back of an adult's bicycle, allowing the child to ride along.

words.ex: The old man built a strange contraption to water his plants.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人造了一个奇妙的装置来给他的植物浇水。
words.en: A contraption is a device or machine that is unusual or complicated, often made in an unusual or complicated way.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.tr: phrase. 使…负载过重；使…装载大量…
words.ex: He is load down with heavy bags.
words.ex_cn: 他被沉重的袋子压得弯下腰。
words.en: To burden someone or something with a heavy load or too much work.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰巨的任务。
words.en: Something that is arduous is difficult and tiring, and involves a lot of effort.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.tr: n. 非法闯入；入室行窃
words.ex: The police investigated a break-in at the store last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了昨晚商店的非法闯入事件。
words.en: An act of illegally entering a building, especially by force, in order to steal something.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: He listens to music to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.ex: He spoke with regard to the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新规定。
words.en: Used to introduce the subject that one is going to talk or write about.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: He drives a fuel-efficient car.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆省油的车。
words.en: Designed to consume less fuel for a given amount of work or travel, thus saving energy and reducing emissions.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr:
n. 提倡者；
v. 提倡；
words.ex: He is an advocate for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁用水的提倡者。
words.en: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly.

words.ex: Children show dependence on their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母有依赖。
words.en: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.tr: adj. 全年的；一年到头的
words.ex: He works year-round at the ice cream shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在冰淇淋店全年工作。
words.en: Something that is year-round exists, happens, or is done throughout the year.

words.tr: phrase. 一年到头； 全年
words.ex: She plays tennis all year round.
words.ex_cn: 她全年都打网球。
words.en: If something happens all year round, it happens throughout the year.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 跳背游戏; v. 玩跳背游戏；越级提升；超过，超越；跨越（障碍）
words.ex: The company decided to leapfrog its competitors by introducing a new technology.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定通过引入新技术来超越其竞争对手。
words.en: Leapfrog is a game in which players vault over each other's stooped backs. It can also mean to move ahead or make progress by skipping over something or someone.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: He worked hard to recoup his losses.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以重获损失的资金。
words.en: To recoup means to regain something lost or to compensate for something, especially money or losses.

words.tr: n. 野火；传播极快的事物；
words.ex: The wildfire spread quickly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 野火迅速蔓延过森林。
words.en: A wildfire is a large, destructive fire that spreads quickly over woodland or brush.

words.ex: The sponge reached saturation and could not hold more water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵达到饱和，再也吸不下更多水了。
words.en: Saturation is the state or process that occurs when no more of something can be absorbed, combined with, or added.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: He decided to switch to a vegetarian diet.
words.ex_cn: 他决定转为素食饮食。
words.en: If you switch to something different, for example to a different system, task, or subject of conversation, you change to it from what you were doing or saying before.

words.tr: adj. 可更新的；可再生的；
words.ex: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是一种可更新的资源。
words.en: A renewable resource is a natural resource which will replenish to replace the portion depleted by usage and consumption, either through natural reproduction or other recurring processes in a finite amount of time in a human time scale.

words.tr: adj. 令人费解的；使人困惑的； v. 混淆；“confuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The instructions are confusing.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明令人费解。
words.en: If something is confusing, it is difficult to understand because it is not clear or is complicated.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.tr: phrase. 注意到；领会；察觉到；继续讨论（某话题）
words.ex: He can quickly pick up on new words in English.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快注意到英语中的新单词。
words.en: To become aware of or notice something, especially something that is not immediately obvious.

words.tr: adj. 无储水罐的：指没有储水罐的设备，如无储水罐热水器，它可以在需要时即时加热水，而无需储存热水...
words.ex: The tankless water heater provides hot water on demand.
words.ex_cn: 无储水罐热水器按需提供热水。
words.en: A tankless device or system does not use a tank.

words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；将……与……相比较（通常用于比喻）
words.ex: We can compare a computer to a brain.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把电脑比作大脑。
words.en: To describe or suggest that someone or something is similar to another person or thing.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: She typically arrives early for class.
words.ex_cn: 她往往很早就到课。
words.en: You use typically to say that something usually happens in the way that you are describing.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: She was immensely happy after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 她赢得奖品后极大地开心。
words.en: To an extremely great extent or degree.

words.tr: adv. 急剧地；引人注目地；
words.ex: The temperature dropped dramatically overnight.
words.ex_cn: 夜间温度急剧下降。
words.en: In a way that is sudden, noticeable, or significant, often in a way that is intended to produce a strong effect.

words.ex: They wrote a love letter every day, and it became their romance.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天写一封情书，这成为了他们的浪漫史。
words.en: Romance refers to the feelings and behaviors characteristic of love, especially in its early stages, or a story, movie, or other work dealing with love in a sentimental or idealized way.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr: phrase. v. 鼓起勇气做某事；勉强自己做某事
words.ex: She couldn't bring herself to tell him the truth.
words.ex_cn: 她无法说服自己去告诉他真相。
words.en: To make oneself do something, especially something that one finds difficult or unpleasant.

words.ex: He will retire next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将退休。
words.en: If you retire, you stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age or because you are ill.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.tr:
n. 心爱的人
adj. 亲爱的
words.ex: My darling, come here for a moment.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的，过来一下。
words.en: A person who is very much loved or liked.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.ex: He has been late for work of late.
words.ex_cn: 最近他上班总是迟到。
words.en: recently; in the recent past

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: He longs for his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望他的家乡。
words.en: To have a strong wish or desire for something.

words.ex: The situation is getting worse by the day.
words.ex_cn: 形势逐日恶化。
words.en: Indicates that something changes or progresses each day.

words.ex: He had a realization that he needed to change his life.
words.ex_cn: 他领悟到自己需要改变生活。
words.en: The act of becoming fully aware of something as a fact; the achievement of something desired or anticipated.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: The police investigated the assault on the old man.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了对那位老人的攻击。
words.en: An assault is a physical attack on someone, or a military attack on a place.

words.ex: Someday, I will visit Paris.
words.ex_cn: 有朝一日，我会去巴黎。
words.en: At some time in the future.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.tr: phrase. 向……鞠躬；顺从，屈服于
words.ex: She had to bow to the majority decision.
words.ex_cn: 她不得不顺从多数人的决定。
words.en: To submit or yield to someone or something, often reluctantly.

words.tr: n. 橄榄球的四分卫; vt. （以四分卫）指挥进攻；领导；操纵; vi. （橄榄球中）担任四分卫
words.ex: He is an excellent quarterback, known for his strategic mind.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名出色的四分卫，以战略思维著称。
words.en: In American football, the quarterback is the player who directs the team's offensive play.

words.tr: adv. 不妥协地；不畏缩地
words.ex: She faced the challenges unflinchingly.
words.ex_cn: 她不畏缩地面对挑战。
words.en: In a way that shows no fear or hesitation in the face of danger or difficulty.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: I sympathize with people who are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些挨饿的人。
words.en: If you sympathize with someone who is in a bad situation, you feel sorry for them.

words.tr: phrase. 同情，怜悯：对他人的困境、痛苦或不幸感到理解和同情。; 赞同，支持：对某人的观点、立场或行为表示理解...
words.ex: I sympathize with people who are tired.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些感到疲惫的人。
words.en: If you sympathize with someone who is in a bad situation, you feel sorry for them and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把…加起来；逐一数出
words.ex: He is counting up the coins in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他正在数他口袋里的硬币。
words.en: To add up numbers or amounts in order to find the total.

words.ex: He had to undergo surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周不得不接受手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.tr: v. 经受；经历；遭受；“undergo”的过去式；
words.ex: He underwent surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周接受了手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.tr: v. 经历；承受；“undergo”的过去分词；
words.ex: He has undergone a big change.
words.ex_cn: 他经历了一次巨大的变化。
words.en: If you undergo something, especially something that is unpleasant or difficult, you experience it or go through it.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.ex: The company will compensate you for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 公司会因延误而补偿你。
words.en: If you compensate for a lack of something or for something you have done wrong, you do something to show that you are sorry or that you are trying to make things better.

words.ex: The company will compensate for the damaged items.
words.ex_cn: 公司将赔偿损坏的物品。
words.en: To compensate for something means to do something to reduce or balance the negative effect of something else.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: The separation of the two chemicals caused a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质的分离引起了反应。
words.en: The act of separating or the state of being separated.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.ex: We have enough food on hand for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们手头有足够的食物用于聚会。
words.en: Available or present; ready for use.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: They decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone something means to arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.

words.tr: n. 享受；乐趣；乐事；享有；
words.ex: She finds enjoyment in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 她从读书中获得享受。
words.en: The pleasure that you get from something.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: He felt lonesome after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonesome, you are unhappy because you are alone or because you have no friends or family with you.

words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.tr:
n. 凝视；注视；
v. 凝视；注视；
words.ex: His gaze fixed on the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他的凝视固定在日落上。
words.en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

words.tr: phrase. 凝视；注视（某人或某物）
words.ex: He gazes upon the stars every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都凝视着星星。
words.en: To look steadily and intently, especially in admiration, surprise, or thought.

words.tr: adj. 感伤的；感情的；多愁善感的
words.ex: He kept the old toy because he was sentimental about it.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了那个旧玩具，因为他对它有感情。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as sentimental, you mean that they are influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.

words.ex: He fills the box with books.
words.ex_cn: 他用书把箱子装满。
words.en: To make something full by putting a substance or thing into it.

words.ex: The heat was inescapable in the small room.
words.ex_cn: 小房间里热得无法逃避。
words.en: If you describe a fact, situation, or activity as inescapable, you mean that it is difficult not to notice it or be affected by it.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr: n. 领班；工头；陪审团主席
words.ex: The foreman told the workers to start the job.
words.ex_cn: 工头告诉工人们开始工作。
words.en: A foreman is a skilled and experienced worker who is in charge of a group of workers, especially in a factory or on a building site.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.ex: The rain wiped the windshield clean.
words.ex_cn: 雨水把挡风玻璃冲干净了。
words.en: The windshield is the window at the front of a vehicle, through which the driver and passengers can see the road ahead.

words.tr: v. 送医院治疗；使住院
words.ex: He was hospitalized after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后被送进了医院。
words.en: To admit someone into a hospital for treatment.

words.ex: The cerebral cortex controls thinking and memory.
words.ex_cn: 大脑皮层控制思考和记忆。
words.en: Relating to the brain or the intellect.

words.ex: He got a concussion after falling off his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来后得了脑震荡。
words.en: A concussion is a type of brain injury that is caused by a blow to the head or body, a fall, or another injury that jars or shakes the brain inside the skull.

words.tr: adj. 无可挑剔的；无瑕疵的；
words.ex: Her impeccable manners impressed everyone at the dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她无可挑剔的礼仪让晚宴上的每个人都印象深刻。
words.en: If you describe something as impeccable, you are emphasizing that it is perfect and has no faults.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: He has amnesia and cannot remember his name.
words.ex_cn: 他患有失忆症，想不起自己的名字。
words.en: Amnesia is a medical condition that affects someone's memory and they are unable to remember events or information.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: He went to a clinic to treat his alcoholism.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所治疗自己的酒精中毒。
words.en: Alcoholism is the condition of being addicted to alcohol.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.tr: phrasal verb. (因受伤、情绪激动等)短暂失去知觉，晕倒；(因电力故障)停电，断电；故意抹去，删去
words.ex: He had to stop working because he started to black out.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不停止工作，因为他开始失去意识。
words.en: To lose consciousness temporarily or to cause an area to lose electricity.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

words.ex: He dozed off during the boring meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的会议上打起了瞌睡。
words.en: To doze means to sleep lightly or for a short period.

words.ex: He uses a razor to shave every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用剃须刀刮胡子。
words.en: A razor is a tool with a sharp blade or set of blades, used to remove hair from the face or body.

words.ex: He brokered a deal between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 他为两家公司安排了协商并达成协议。
words.en: A broker is a person whose job is to buy and sell shares, foreign money, or goods for other people.

words.tr:
n. 窥探；杠杆；爱打探的人
v. 打听；窥探；用杠杆撬开
words.ex: His pry into my private messages made me angry.
words.ex_cn: 他窥探我的私信让我很生气。
words.en: To try to find out private information about someone or something in a way that is annoying or rude.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: She was elated when she won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 她获奖时非常高兴。
words.en: To make someone feel very happy and excited.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息；倒抽气
n. 喘气；喘息
words.ex: He gasped when he saw the big snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到那条大蛇时，他倒吸了一口冷气。
words.en: To take a short, quick breath through the mouth, especially because of surprise, pain, or shock.

words.ex: The loud noise stunned him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他震惊了。
words.en: To stun someone means to shock or surprise them very much.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.ex: He swore he didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓他没有偷钱。
words.en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

words.ex: He took an oath to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要说出真相。
words.en: An oath is a formal promise, especially one made in a court of law or a religious ceremony, or a swear word.

words.ex: He joined a fraternity at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学加入了兄弟会。
words.en: Fraternity refers to a group of people sharing a common profession or interests, or a feeling of friendship and mutual support within a group.

words.ex: I occasionally walk my dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔在公园遛狗。
words.en: If something happens occasionally, it happens sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: He stopped talking abruptly.
words.ex_cn: 他突然停止了说话。
words.en: Suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He made an abrupt stop at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 他在红灯前突然停了下来。
words.en: If something happens abruptly, it happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.tr: adj. 书本上的；好读书的；书呆子气的
words.ex: He is too bookish and doesn't know real life.
words.ex_cn: 他太书本气了，不懂现实生活。
words.en: Someone who is bookish spends a lot of time reading serious books and is more interested in ideas than in people or activities.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: The loud noise exasperates me.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让我感到烦躁。
words.en: If someone or something exasperates you, they annoy you and make you feel frustrated or impatient.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.tr: adj. 又苦又甜的；苦乐参半的；
words.ex: The goodbye party was bittersweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个告别派对又苦又甜。
words.en: If you describe an experience as bittersweet, you mean that it has both happy and sad aspects.

words.ex: She was betrothed to a wealthy businessman.
words.ex_cn: 她与一位富商订婚了。
words.en: To promise to marry someone or to be married to someone.

words.ex: The procession moved slowly down the street.
words.ex_cn: 行列缓缓沿着街道行进。
words.en: A procession is a group of people who are walking, riding, or driving in a line as part of a public event.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: She mourns her dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都在哀悼她的狗。
words.en: To feel or express deep sorrow or regret for someone or something.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: He spoke without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地说了。
words.en: Hesitation is the act of pausing before doing something, especially because you are nervous or not certain about it.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.tr: phrase. 无论怎样；无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: No matter how hard he tries, he cannot solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 无论他多么努力，都解不出这道题。
words.en: Regardless of the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: I will help you, no matter what.
words.ex_cn: 无论怎样，我都会帮你。
words.en: Regardless of what happens or what the circumstances are.

words.tr: phrase. 无论是否；不管是否
words.ex: No matter whether it rains or shines, we will go hiking tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: conj. 无论是否下雨或晴天，我们明天都会去远足。
words.en: used to say that something is true or will happen whatever the situation is

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr:
v. 使不再抱幻想；使理想破灭
n. 幻灭；理想破灭
words.ex: The bad experience disillusioned him about politics.
words.ex_cn: 这次糟糕的经历让他对政治不再抱幻想。
words.en: If a person or thing disillusions you, they make you realize that something is not as good as you thought it was.

words.tr: phrase. 悄悄离开；溜走；逐渐消逝
words.ex: He slipped away without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄离开了，没有说再见。
words.en: To leave a place quietly or secretly, or to gradually disappear or become less.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: They decided to relocate to a quieter town.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定搬到一个更安静的城镇。
words.en: to move to a new place and establish one's home or business there

words.ex: I cannot help but smile when I see my dog.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到我的狗时，我忍不住微笑。
words.en: If you say that you cannot help doing something, you mean that you cannot prevent yourself from doing it.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.tr: adj. 延长的；扩大范围的；延伸的；
words.ex: The meeting was extended by thirty minutes.
words.ex_cn: 会议被延长了三十分钟。
words.en: Made larger or longer than usual.

words.tr: abbr. 诸如此类；等等；“et cetera”的缩写
words.ex: I bought apples, bananas, etc.
words.ex_cn: 我买了苹果、香蕉等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that further, similar items are included.

words.ex: The breakup of the team made everyone sad.
words.ex_cn: 团队的分裂让每个人都很难过。
words.en: The end of a relationship, partnership, or association.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.ex: The closure of the store was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 商店的关闭很突然。
words.en: The act of closing something, or the state of being closed.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.tr: v. 背叛；出卖；泄露；暴露
words.ex: He betrays his friend by telling the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他通过泄露秘密背叛了朋友。
words.en: If you betray someone who loves or trusts you, your actions hurt and disappoint them.

words.ex: He forgot his money, so he ended up with nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了带钱，结果什么也没有。
words.en: To eventually be in a particular situation or place, often without intending to.

words.ex: Much as I admire her courage, I think she is reckless.
words.ex_cn: 尽管我佩服她的勇气，我认为她太鲁莽了。
words.en: Although; even though.

words.ex: He eats as much as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和他兄弟一样多。
words.en: You use 'as much as' to say that something is true to the same extent as something else.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.tr: adv. 非故意地；无意之中；
words.ex: He unintentionally broke the vase.
words.ex_cn: 他非故意地打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something unintentionally, you do it without intending to do it.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，雨停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.tr:
n. 刚长齐羽毛学飞的幼鸟
adj. 新形成的；无经验的
v. 羽毛长成；用羽毛盖上；装上羽毛；“fledge”的现在分词
words.ex: The fledgling bird tried to fly for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这只幼鸟第一次尝试飞翔。
words.en: A fledgling is a young bird that has just grown its feathers and is learning to fly. It can also refer to a person or organization that is new and inexperienced.

words.ex: When it comes to math, he always feels nervous.
words.ex_cn: 说到数学，他总是感到紧张。
words.en: You use 'when it comes to' to introduce a subject or activity that you are about to discuss or deal with.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: The medicine helped revive the sick man.
words.ex_cn: 这剂药帮助这位病人恢复了生机。
words.en: To revive something means to bring it back to life, consciousness, or use, or to make it active or successful again.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 恢复；重新振作；反弹
words.ex: He bounced back after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他伤愈后恢复了。
words.en: To return quickly to a normal condition after a difficult situation or event.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.ex: The cows trample the grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 牛在田野里践踏草地。
words.en: If someone tramples something or tramples on it, they step heavily and carelessly on it and damage it.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr: phrase. 在开头时；从一开始
words.ex: At the outset, he said he would help.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他说他会帮忙。
words.en: At the beginning of something.

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.ex: He firmly believes in truth.
words.ex_cn: 他坚定地相信真理。
words.en: In a way that is strong and not likely to change or move.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.tr: adv. 鲁莽地；不顾后果地
words.ex: He drove recklessly through the city streets.
words.ex_cn: 他鲁莽地在城市街道上驾驶。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr: adj. 难以想象的；不可思议的；难以置信的；
words.ex: It is unthinkable to leave a child alone in the car.
words.ex_cn: 把孩子单独留在车里是难以想象的。
words.en: If something is unthinkable, it cannot be imagined or considered because it is so bad, impossible, or unlikely to happen.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He testified that he saw the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他证明自己看到了那起事故。
words.en: To testify means to make a statement based on personal knowledge or belief, especially in a court of law, or to serve as evidence or proof of something's existence or truth.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: The legality of the contract is being checked.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同的合法性正在被检查。
words.en: The state or quality of being in accordance with the law.

words.ex: The movie was fairly interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影相当地有趣。
words.en: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree.

words.tr: adj. 担心的；关注的； v. 涉及到；“concern”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My parents are concerned about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我的成绩感到担心。
words.en: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr: phrase. 支持；捍卫；为…挺身而出
words.ex: He will stand up for his friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对他的朋友刻薄时，他会为朋友挺身而出。
words.en: To support or defend someone or something.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；遵守；袖手旁观；准备行动
words.ex: I will stand by you when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我会支持你。
words.en: To be ready to support or act if needed; to wait in a state of readiness.

words.tr: phrase. 在……时期；在……时候；在……之际
words.ex: In times of crisis, people often come together to support each other.
words.ex_cn: 在危机时期，人们往往会团结起来互相支持。
words.en: During a period of

words.ex: The teacher showed fairness in grading all students.
words.ex_cn: 老师在给所有学生评分时展现了公平。
words.en: Fairness is the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is right or reasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 忠实于；符合；与…一致
words.ex: She remained true to her principles throughout her career.
words.ex_cn: 她在整个职业生涯中始终忠于自己的原则。
words.en: Faithful or loyal to a person, principle, or cause.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 想要某物；感觉像某事；有做某事的感觉
words.ex: I don't feel like going out tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚不想出去。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to seem or appear to be something.

words.tr: 表示想要做某事，有做某事的意愿或冲动
words.ex: I feel like eating pizza today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination to do something.

words.ex: The water is sufficiently warm to swim.
words.ex_cn: 水温足够暖和，可以游泳。
words.en: To an adequate degree; enough.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.tr: v. 控制；操纵；“control”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is controlling the robot with a remote.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用遥控器控制机器人。
words.en: If someone is controlling, they try to control other people or situations in a way that is not helpful or that prevents people from being able to make their own decisions.

words.tr: phrase. 管好自己；别多管闲事；少管他人的事
words.ex: He always tells others what to do, but he should mind his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他总是告诉别人该做什么，但他应该管好自己的事。
words.en: To refrain from interfering in the affairs of others; to focus on one's own concerns.

words.tr: adv. 由衷地；真诚地；真正地；
words.ex: I genuinely appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我由衷地感谢你的帮助。
words.en: If you describe something as genuine, you mean that it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is normal for you.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.tr: phrase. 干预；介入；插手；调停
words.ex: The teacher will intervene in the fight.
words.ex_cn: 老师会介入这场打斗。
words.en: To become involved in a situation in order to improve or help it.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.tr:
n. 寓言；神话传说；无稽之谈
v. 虚构
words.ex: The old man told a fable about a fox and a crow.
words.ex_cn: 老人讲了一个关于狐狸和乌鸦的寓言。
words.en: A fable is a short story that typically features animals as characters and conveys a moral lesson.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.ex: The caravan stopped at several oases along the desert route.
words.ex_cn: 商队沿着沙漠路线在几个绿洲停了下来。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.tr:
n. 泥潭；泥沼；困境
v. 使陷进泥坑里
words.ex: The car got stuck in the mire.
words.ex_cn: 汽车陷在泥沼里了。
words.en: Mire refers to an area of wet, soggy ground or a difficult situation from which it is hard to extricate oneself.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.tr: n. 宽恕；原谅；宽宏大量
words.ex: He showed forgiveness after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵之后，他表现出了宽恕。
words.en: The action or process of forgiving or being forgiven.

words.ex: He erased the wrong answer with an eraser.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了错误的答案。
words.en: To erase something means to remove it completely from a surface or from a place where it is stored.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: He engraves his name on the ring.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在戒指上。
words.en: To engrave means to cut or carve a design or letters into a hard surface, or to be strongly impressed in someone's memory.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: He had no recourse but to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他别无依靠，只能求助。
words.en: If you have recourse to a particular course of action, you use it when you are in a difficult situation or when you need to achieve something.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: They pray to God every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上向上帝祈祷。
words.en: To speak to a god or gods in order to express thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.tr: n. 幸事； v. “bless”的现在分词；
words.ex: Finding a good job after graduation was a blessing.
words.ex_cn: 毕业后找到一份好工作是一件幸事。
words.en: A blessing is a prayer asking for God's favor and protection, or a beneficial thing for which one is grateful.

words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他马上就要离开家了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，马上就要做某事
words.ex: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 我正要离开时电话响了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.ex: He walked home with his companion.
words.ex_cn: 他和同伴一起走回家。
words.en: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

words.ex: He deserves a break after working so hard.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作后值得休息一下。
words.en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: adj. 搞错的；弄错的；误解的； v. “mistake”的过去分词；
words.ex: He was mistaken about the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他对会议的时间搞错了。
words.en: If you are mistaken about something, you are wrong about it.

words.tr:
v. 指责；斥责
n. 指责；谴责
words.ex: The teacher gave him a rebuke for talking in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他上课讲话而责备了他。
words.en: If you rebuke someone, you speak severely to them because they have said or done something that you do not approve of.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr:
n. 小睡；打盹；
v. 小睡；打盹；
words.ex: He took a short nap after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡了一会儿。
words.en: If you have a nap, you have a short sleep, usually during the day.

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 被……淹没；收到大量……
words.ex: The school is flooded with applications this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年学校收到了大量的申请。
words.en: To be filled or overwhelmed with a large quantity of something.

words.ex: The fluorescent lamp lights up the room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 荧光灯很快照亮了房间。
words.en: Fluorescent substances produce bright light of a particular color when they are exposed to light of a different wavelength.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.tr: v. 起绰号；把…称作；配音；译制
words.ex: They dubbed him 'Captain Cool' for his calm style.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他冷静的风格给他起了个绰号叫‘冷静队长’。
words.en: To give a name, title, or nickname to someone or something; to provide a film or television program with a soundtrack in a different language from the original.

words.ex: He felt so sad that he thought about suicide.
words.ex_cn: 他感到非常难过，以至于想到了自杀。
words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.tr: n. 教规；准则；真作集；精品集；大教堂教士
words.ex: The church follows the canon of its faith.
words.ex_cn: 教会遵循其信仰的教规。
words.en: A canon is a rule or principle that is considered to be established, accepted, or authoritative, especially in the fields of religion, literature, or law.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.tr:
adj. 诱人的；迷人的；有吸引力的
v. 诱惑；吸引；“allure”的现在分词
words.ex: The city's nightlife is alluring to many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的夜生活对许多游客来说都极具诱惑力。
words.en: Something that is alluring is powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating.

words.ex: He yearns for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望更好的生活。
words.en: If you yearn for something, you want it very much.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.ex: He tries to memorize the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天试着记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorize something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: His provocative words made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他挑衅的话让所有人都生气了。
words.en: If you describe something as provocative, you mean that it is intended to make people react angrily or argue against it.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.ex: He analyzes data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He is destined to become a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他注定会成为一名优秀的老师。
words.en: If you say that someone is destined to do something, you mean that it seems certain to happen because it has been decided by fate or by a higher power.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉有义务做某事；觉得必须
words.ex: I feel obligated to help my friend when he is in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 当我的朋友遇到麻烦时，我觉得有义务帮助他。
words.en: To feel that one has a duty to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 感到有义务做某事；觉得不得不做某事
words.ex: He felt obligated to help his friend in need.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得有义务帮助需要帮助的朋友。
words.en: To feel that you must do something because it is your duty or because you think it is right.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.tr: phrase. 拆开；撕碎；使分离；严厉批评
words.ex: The children were excited to pull apart the new toy to see how it worked.
words.ex_cn: v. 孩子们兴奋地拆开新玩具，想看看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into pieces by pulling; to analyze something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 恳求某人；向某人求情；向某人哀求
words.ex: She pleaded with her parents to let her go to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 她恳求父母让她去听音乐会。
words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.w: plead with sb. to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 恳求某人做某事；哀求某人做某事
words.uk: pliːd wɪð ɛsb tu duː sth
words.us: plid wɪð ɛsb tu doʊ sth
words.ex: She pleaded with him to reconsider his decision.
words.ex_cn: 她恳求他重新考虑他的决定。
