words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 上床睡觉；上交；告发；交还
words.ex: It's late, so I'll turn in now.
words.ex_cn: 很晚了，我现在上床睡觉。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or something that is lost.

words.ex: He lingered by the door, not wanting to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他逗留在门口，不想离开。
words.en: If you linger somewhere, you stay there for a longer time than is necessary, for example because you are enjoying yourself.

words.tr: phrase. , n.突然出现：指突然从隐藏的位置迅速出现或活动。; 弹出式：指在打开页面时形成一个立体结构的设备或插图。...
words.ex: A message will pop up when you open the app.
words.ex_cn: 当你打开应用程序时，会弹出一条消息。
words.en: If something such as a message or window pops up on a computer screen, it appears there suddenly.

words.tr: adj. 按时间先后顺序排列的
words.ex: The events are listed in chronological order.
words.ex_cn: 这些事件按时间顺序列出。
words.en: If things are described or shown in chronological order, they are described or shown in the order in which they happened.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为由；基于……的理由
words.ex: He was fired on moral grounds.
words.ex_cn: 他因道德原因被解雇了。
words.en: Used to indicate the reason or justification for something.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为理由；基于……的原因；根据
words.ex: He was expelled from school on the grounds of misconduct.
words.ex_cn: 他因行为不端被学校开除。
words.en: Because of a particular reason or reasons.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: phrase. 认真处理...；设法对付…；与...扭打
words.ex: He is trying to get to grips with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他正努力掌握基础数学。
words.en: To begin to deal with or understand something seriously.

words.tr: phrase. v. 认真处理；着手应对；正视（问题或现实）
words.ex: He needs to come to grips with his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他需要面对并克服自己对当众讲话的恐惧。
words.en: If you come to grips with a problem or challenge, you start to deal with it or understand it.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.tr: adj. 澳大利亚及亚洲的；澳大拉西亚的
words.ex: The Australasian region is known for its unique wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 澳大拉西亚地区以其独特的野生动物而闻名。
words.en: Relating to Australasia, a region that includes Australia, New Zealand, and some neighbouring islands in the Pacific Ocean.

words.tr: n. 实习工作；安排；放置；
words.ex: He got a placement at a local company this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天获得了一份在本地公司的实习工作。
words.en: The act of placing something or someone in a particular position or the process of finding a suitable place or job for someone.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: v. 使气馁；使胆怯；吓倒
words.ex: The loud noise did not daunt her.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音并没有吓倒她。
words.en: If something daunts you, it makes you feel slightly afraid or worried about dealing with it.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.tr: adj. 全世界的；四海一家的；
words.ex: This city has a cosmopolitan population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着来自世界各地的人口。
words.en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

words.ex: The makeup of the team includes students from five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的组成包括来自五个国家的学生。
words.en: Makeup refers to substances applied to the face to improve or alter the appearance, or the way in which something is composed or arranged.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己沉浸于；专心于；埋头于
words.ex: He likes to immerse himself in simple books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上沉浸在简单的书籍中。
words.en: To involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: He drinks a cup of espresso every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯浓咖啡。
words.en: A strong coffee made by forcing steam or hot water through ground coffee beans.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.ex: He is a prospective student at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的预期学生。
words.en: Prospective is used to describe someone or something that is expected or likely to happen or be in the future.

words.ex: The car has an add-on for better sound.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个用于更好音效的附加装置。
words.en: An add-on is something that is added to a product, especially a computer program, to give it extra features or functions.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr:
v. 做实习生；扣留
n. 实习生
words.ex: He is interning at a hospital this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天在医院做实习生。
words.en: An intern is someone who works in a temporary position with an emphasis on on-the-job training rather than merely employment, often to gain experience in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.tr: phrase. 按日地；日常地；每天地；在日常运作层面上
words.ex: We manage our finances on a day-to-day basis.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天管理我们的财务。
words.en: If something happens on a day-to-day basis, it happens regularly every day.

words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 一定会做某事；注定要做某事
words.ex_cn: 如果他努力学习，他一定会通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: n. 官僚主义；官僚机构
words.ex: He hates the bureaucracy in government offices.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌政府办公室里的官僚主义。
words.en: Bureaucracy refers to a system of government or business that has many complicated rules and ways of doing things.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.tr: adj. 有动机的；有积极性的； v. 激发；“motivate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is motivated to study hard for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他有动力努力为考试学习。
words.en: If you are motivated by something, especially a strong emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: He is self-funded during his PhD.
words.ex_cn: 他在攻读博士学位期间自费。
words.en: Self-funded refers to something that is financed by one's own resources rather than external funding.

words.tr: adj. 自费的；自筹资金的
words.ex: He pursued a self-sponsored research project.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了一个自费的研究项目。
words.en: Self-sponsored refers to something that is paid for or supported by oneself, without external financial assistance.

words.tr: adj. 人口统计的；人口的；
words.ex: The survey collected demographic data like age and income.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查收集了年龄和收入等人口统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the structure of populations.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He crammed the suitcase with clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服塞满了行李箱。
words.en: If you cram things or people into a place, you put them into it even though there is hardly enough room for them.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…施加很大压力；在…方面过重；过分依赖或强调某事物
words.ex: This book is heavy on math and light on stories.
words.ex_cn: 这本书数学内容多，故事内容少。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something, often unpleasant.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: He is learning vocational skills to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业技能以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Relating to the skills you need to do a particular job.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.tr: n. 监视器；看守人；岗哨
words.ex: The watcher recorded the activity through the camera.
words.ex_cn: 监视器通过摄像头记录了活动。
words.en: A watcher is someone who watches or observes something or someone, often to ensure that nothing bad happens.

words.ex: He opined that the new policy would benefit the company.
words.ex_cn: 他认为新政策将对公司有利。
words.en: To opine means to express an opinion.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.tr: phrase. 引申而言；由此推论
words.ex: By extension, this theory also applies to the field of economics.
words.ex_cn: adv. 引申地，这一理论也适用于经济学领域。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is a logical or natural consequence of something else.

words.ex: He showed skepticism about the new claim.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新说法持怀疑态度。
words.en: Skepticism is a questioning attitude or doubt towards one or more items of putative knowledge or belief.

words.tr: phrase. 使……占据优势；让……略胜一筹
words.ex: Good sleep gives you the edge in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 充足的睡眠让你在考试中占据优势。
words.en: To provide someone with a slight advantage over others.

words.tr: phrase. 给予……优势；使……处于有利地位
words.ex: Good sleep gives you an edge in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 充足的睡眠让你在考试中占有优势。
words.en: To give someone or something a slight advantage.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.ex: Legend has it that a pirate buried gold on this island.
words.ex_cn: 传说有个海盗把黄金埋在了这个岛上。
words.en: According to a traditional story or popular belief.

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.tr: 短语动词. 起源于；根植于（某地或某种情况）
words.ex: Her love for music has its roots in childhood.
words.ex_cn: 她对音乐的热爱源于童年。
words.en: To originate or be derived from a particular source or cause.

words.ex: The veracity of his story was questioned by the police.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事的真实性受到了警方的质疑。
words.en: Veracity refers to the quality of being true or accurate.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.ex: We watched fireworks on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我们在除夕夜看了烟火。
words.en: Fireworks are small explosive devices that produce colorful displays of light and noise, typically used in celebrations.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.ex: It's risky to walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路是危险的。
words.en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 马具；
words.ex: We must harness the power of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须利用太阳的能量。
words.en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.

words.ex: The spaceship flew to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船飞到了月球。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for travel or operation in outer space.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.tr: adj. 惊天动地的；极其重大的
words.ex: The discovery was earth-shattering, changing the course of science forever.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现惊天动地，永远改变了科学的发展轨迹。
words.en: Something that is earth-shattering is extremely surprising, important, or impressive.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: His story is far-fetched and not believable.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事牵强附会，不可信。
words.en: If you describe a story or idea as far-fetched, you mean that it is very unlikely to be true or practical.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.ex: He dreams of spaceflight when he grows up.
words.ex_cn: 他长大后梦想去太空飞行。
words.en: Spaceflight is the act of travelling in space, especially by a spacecraft.

words.ex: The onlooker watched the accident quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地看着这起事故。
words.en: A person who watches something happening without taking part in it.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: His nickname is 'Speedy' because he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的绰号是‘飞毛腿’，因为他跑得快。
words.en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.tr: 短语动词. 保持一项纪录；创下并维持某项记录
words.ex: He holds a record for running the fastest mile.
words.ex_cn: 他保持着跑一英里最快的世界纪录。
words.en: To maintain a record of the highest achievement or performance in a particular area.

words.tr: 短语动词. 打破纪录；创造新纪录
words.ex: He runs fast and breaks a record.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，打破了纪录。
words.en: To achieve a better performance than has ever been achieved before in a particular activity or sport.

words.tr: phrase. 创造纪录；创下记录
words.ex: She set a record by running a marathon in under two hours.
words.ex_cn: 她创下了不到两小时跑完马拉松的纪录。
words.en: To achieve the best performance in a particular activity, especially in sports, that has been officially measured and recognized.

words.ex: The eagle has a wide wingspan.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹰的翼展很宽。
words.en: The wingspan of a bird or an aircraft is the distance from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The problem has too much complexity.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题太复杂了。
words.en: Complexity is the state of having many different parts connected or related to each other in a complicated way.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 落后于计划；误点；拖延的
words.ex: The train is behind schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: If someone or something is behind schedule, they are not progressing as quickly as planned or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 把…存进仓库；把…储存起来；把…放入存储设备
words.ex: He puts his books into storage when he moves.
words.ex_cn: 他搬家时把书放进仓库。
words.en: To place something in a location where it will be kept until it is needed again.

words.ex: The paintings are on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: If something is on display, it is arranged for people to look at in a public place.

words.tr: phrase. 展出；陈列；展示；公开展示
words.ex: They put the painting on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他们把这幅画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: To exhibit or show something publicly.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: In the field of refers to being involved in a particular area of study or activity.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 超前于时代的；思想或行为远远领先于所处时代的人
words.ex: Her ideas were ahead of her time, so people did not understand them at first.
words.ex_cn: 她的想法超前于时代，所以人们一开始并不理解。
words.en: Being more advanced or innovative than is typical for the current period.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The old man gave an enigmatic smile.
words.ex_cn: 那位老人露出了一个神秘的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as enigmatic, you mean they are mysterious and difficult to understand.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: The magic show had a strange fascination for children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演对孩子们有一种奇特的迷惑力。
words.en: A fascination is a very strong interest or attraction for someone or something.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: He sent his curriculum vitae to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A curriculum vitae is a written account of your education and the jobs you have done, which you send when you are applying for a job.

words.tr: 短语。令人羡慕的对象；令…嫉妒的人或事物
words.ex: He is the envy of all his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他是所有同学羡慕的对象。
words.en: A source of envy or admiration for others.

words.tr: 短语动词. 成为...羡慕的对象；令...嫉妒
words.ex: Her beautiful garden is the envy of all her neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 她美丽的花园让所有的邻居都羡慕不已。
words.en: If you are the envy of someone, they wish very much that they could have or achieve the same thing as you.

words.tr: adj. 超轻型的; n. 超轻型飞机
words.ex: He built an ultralight aircraft in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院造了一架超轻型飞机。
words.en: An ultralight object or material is extremely light in weight.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr: phrase. 即将做某事；准备做某事
words.ex: The team is set to win the championship this year.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍今年有望赢得冠军。
words.en: If someone is set to do something, they are ready to do it or are likely to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: He ate a piece of Swiss cheese for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一片瑞士奶酪。
words.en: Relating to Switzerland or its people or culture.

words.ex: The piano duo played a beautiful song.
words.ex_cn: 这对钢琴二重奏演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A duo is a pair of people or things, especially musicians or performers, who work together or are associated in some way.

words.tr: v. 摘下面纱；揭幕；揭露
words.ex: They will unveil the statue tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将摘下雕像的面纱。
words.en: If someone unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they show it to the public for the first time.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: He won three successive championships.
words.ex_cn: 他连续赢得了三届冠军。
words.en: Following one after the other without interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 碳纤维；一种高强度、轻质的复合材料，常用于航空航天、汽车和体育器材制造
words.ex: The bike frame is made of lightweight carbon fiber.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车的车架是用轻质的碳纤维制成的。
words.en: Carbon fiber is a material consisting of extremely thin fibers of carbon, used chiefly as a strengthening material in composite materials.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.ex: The ground is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 地面被雪覆盖。
words.en: To have something spread over or upon a surface.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: The suit was custom-made to fit his body perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这套西装是量身定制的，完美贴合他的身材。
words.en: Made to the specifications of the individual customer.

words.ex: He uses lithium to treat his mood disorder.
words.ex_cn: 他用锂来治疗自己的情绪障碍。
words.en: Lithium is a soft, silver-white metal that is the lightest of the alkali metals. It is used in batteries, especially for mobile phones and electric vehicles.

words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.tr: n. 飞机座舱；赛车座舱；
words.ex: The pilot checked the instruments in the cockpit.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在飞机座舱里检查了仪表。
words.en: The compartment where the pilot sits in an aircraft, from which the aircraft is controlled.

words.ex: Theoretically, the plan should work.
words.ex_cn: 理论上，这个计划应该可行。
words.en: In a way that relates to the theory of a subject or area of study rather than its practical application.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: He calculates the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算出总成本。
words.en: To determine by mathematical methods; compute.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: The prices range from 5 to 10 dollars.
words.ex_cn: 价格从5美元到10美元不等。
words.en: To vary or extend between specified limits.

words.tr: phrase. 在缺乏…的情况下；在没有…时
words.ex: He left the meeting in the absence of his boss.
words.ex_cn: 在老板不在的情况下，他离开了会议。
words.en: If something happens in the absence of a particular thing, it happens when that thing is not there or when that thing is not available.

words.tr: phrase. 救生筏；充气救生艇
words.ex: The sailors quickly boarded the life raft when the ship started sinking.
words.ex_cn: 当船开始下沉时，水手们迅速登上了救生筏。
words.en: A life raft is a small, inflatable boat that is used for emergency situations at sea, designed to keep people afloat until they can be rescued.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.tr: v. 躺；靠在；向后倾斜（坐椅）
words.ex: He reclines on the sofa after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后躺在沙发上。
words.en: To recline means to lean or lie back in a relaxed position with the body supported.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: n. 模拟装置；仿真器；模拟程序
words.ex: He uses a flight simulator to practice flying.
words.ex_cn: 他使用飞行模拟器来练习飞行。
words.en: A simulator is a device that artificially creates the effect of being in conditions of some kind, often for the purpose of training or testing.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.tr: v. 使可见；使形象化；设想；
words.ex: He uses maps to visualize the data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用地图来使数据可见。
words.en: If you visualize something, you imagine what it is like by forming a mental picture of it.

words.tr: n. 保证；事业； v. 承担；从事；“undertake”的现在分词；
words.ex: He gave an undertaking to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他保证按时完成项目。
words.en: An undertaking is a task or project, especially one that is important or difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 成功到达（某地）；及时赶到；成功做到
words.ex: He worked hard to make it to the final round.
words.ex_cn: 他努力奋斗，终于进入了决赛。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place, especially when this is difficult or when there is some doubt about whether you will succeed.

words.tr: n. 平流层；同温层；最高层；
words.ex: Planes fly in the stratosphere to avoid bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在平流层飞行以避开恶劣天气。
words.en: The stratosphere is the second major layer of Earth's atmosphere, just above the troposphere, and below the mesosphere. It is characterized by a slight temperature increase with altitude and the presence of the ozone layer, which absorbs and scatters the solar ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr: phrase. 跟随某人的脚步；效仿某人；继承某人的事业或做法
words.ex: She decided to follow in her father's footsteps and become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 她决定效仿父亲，成为一名医生。
words.en: To do the same thing as someone else, especially someone in your family, did before you.

words.ex: He started to learn English early on.
words.ex_cn: 他很早就开始学英语了。
words.en: At an early stage of a period of time or process.

words.tr: phrase. 与…联合；与…合作；与…协力
words.ex: The two companies decided to join forces with each other to compete against the larger corporations.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司决定联合起来，以对抗更大的公司。
words.en: To combine efforts or resources with someone or something in order to achieve a common goal.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: He will embark on a new journey next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将开始一段新的旅程。
words.en: To start or begin something, especially something new, challenging, or exciting.

words.tr: adj. 高的；崇高的；傲慢的
words.ex: The mountain has a lofty peak.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一个很高的山顶。
words.en: If you say that someone behaves in a lofty way, you are critical of them for behaving in a proud and rather unpleasant way, as if they think they are very important.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.ex: She started saving money with the aim of buying a new car.
words.ex_cn: 她开始存钱，目的是买一辆新车。
words.en: With the intention or purpose of achieving something.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: He always follows the maxim 'work hard, play hard'.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循‘努力工作，尽情玩耍’这一信条。
words.en: A maxim is a short, easily remembered expression of a basic principle, general truth, or rule of conduct.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.tr: phrase. v. 发射升空；（火箭、航天器等）起飞
words.ex: The rocket will blast off at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火箭将在下午3点发射。
words.en: When a spacecraft blasts off, it leaves the ground at the start of its journey.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: I feel honoured to be invited to speak at the conference.
words.ex_cn: 我感到很荣幸被邀请在会议上发言。
words.en: Feeling proud and happy because you have been given special respect or a special opportunity.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.ex: He raised an objection to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了反对。
words.en: An objection is an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: v.雇用工作人员（staff 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The office was fully staffed by the end of the week.
words.ex_cn: 到周末时，办公室已全面配备了工作人员。
words.en: Provided with staff or personnel.

words.tr:
n. 对接
adj. 入坞的
v. 停靠码头；“dock”的现在分词
words.ex: The docking of the spacecraft was a smooth process.
words.ex_cn: 航天器的对接过程很顺利。
words.en: The act of bringing a ship or spacecraft into a dock or space station.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.ex: Generally speaking, most students like math.
words.ex_cn: 一般来说，大多数学生喜欢数学。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or as a general rule.

words.ex: The durability of this plastic makes it good for outdoor use.
words.ex_cn: 这种塑料的持久性使它适合户外使用。
words.en: The ability of something to last a long time without significant deterioration.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.ex: The stability of the table prevents it from wobbling.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的固定防止它摇晃。
words.en: The state of being stable; the quality of being unchanging.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
words.en: A conductor is a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir, or a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: She is always supportive of her friends' decisions.
words.ex_cn: 她总是支持她朋友的决定。
words.en: To be supportive of someone or something means to give help or encouragement to them.

words.tr: phrase. 对…心存感激的；感谢…的
words.ex: We should be thankful to our parents for their unconditional love.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该感谢父母给予的无条件的爱。
words.en: To feel or express gratitude to someone for something they have done.

words.tr:
v. 移动；操控；
n. （熟练地）移动；
words.ex: He manoeuvred the car into a small parking space.
words.ex_cn: 他把车开进了一个小停车位。
words.en: A manoeuvre is a movement or series of movements requiring skill and care, especially in military tactics or in driving a vehicle. It can also refer to a clever or cunning plan or action designed to turn a situation to one's own advantage.

words.tr: n. 骇客空间，黑客空间，创客空间
words.ex: The hackerspace is a place where tech enthusiasts gather to collaborate and innovate.
words.ex_cn: 创客空间是技术爱好者聚集在一起合作和创新的地方。
words.en: A hackerspace (also referred to as a hacklab, makerspace, or hackspace) is a community-operated workspace where people with common interests, often in computers, technology, science, digital art or electronic art, can meet, socialize and collaborate.

words.tr: phrase. 属于自己的；自己专有的
words.ex: Every child should have a room of his own.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都应该有自己的房间。
words.en: belonging to oneself and no one else

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He likes to tinker with old radios in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间鼓捣旧收音机。
words.en: To tinker with something means to make small changes or repairs to it, especially in an attempt to improve it or fix it.

words.ex: Her mother gave her encouragement before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 考试前，她妈妈给了她鼓励。
words.en: Encouragement is the act of giving someone support, confidence, or hope.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.tr:
n. 焊料；焊锡
v. 焊接；焊合
words.ex: He used solder to fix the broken wire.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊料修理了断掉的电线。
words.en: Solder is a fusible metal alloy used to create a permanent bond between metal workpieces.

words.ex: The project is an open-source initiative aimed at promoting transparency.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是一个旨在促进透明的开源计划。
words.en: Open-source software is software with source code that anyone can inspect, modify, and enhance.

words.ex: The microcontroller is a key component in the embedded system.
words.ex_cn: 微控制器是嵌入式系统中的一个关键组件。
words.en: A microcontroller is a small computer on a single integrated circuit containing a processor core, memory, and programmable input/output peripherals.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr: abbr. 自己动手做（Do It Yourself）；
words.ex: He made a bookshelf by himself using diy tools.
words.ex_cn: 他用自己动手做的工具做了一个书架。
words.en: DIY is the activity of making or repairing things yourself, especially in your home, rather than paying someone else to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐取得进展；获得优势；变得流行或被接受
words.ex: The new idea is gaining ground among young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个新想法正在年轻人中逐渐流行起来。
words.en: To make progress or become more popular or accepted.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr: v. 劈砍；侵入（计算机等）
words.ex: He hacked the tree with an axe.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧头劈砍那棵树。
words.en: To hack means to cut or chop something with rough or heavy blows, or to gain unauthorized access to data in a system or computer.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.ex: The makerspace offers a variety of tools and materials for creative projects.
words.ex_cn: 创客空间提供各种工具和材料用于创意项目。
words.en: A makerspace is a collaborative work space inside a school, library or separate public/private facility for making, learning, exploring and sharing that uses high tech to no tech tools.

words.ex: He works on his desktop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在台式机上工作。
words.en: The top of a desk; a computer that is designed to be used on a desk.

words.ex: They did a collaborative project in class.
words.ex_cn: 他们在课堂上做了一个合作项目。
words.en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.tr: phrase. 秘密地；暗地里；私下地
words.ex: They were meeting in secret to discuss their plans.
words.ex_cn: 他们秘密会面讨论他们的计划。
words.en: Done, made, or conducted without the knowledge of others.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.tr: n. 导管；管道；水管；水道
words.ex: The cable is a conduit for electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这根电缆是电的通道。
words.en: A conduit is a channel or pipe for conveying water or other fluid.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.ex: He is an innovator who created a new app.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创造了新应用程序的创新者。
words.en: An innovator is someone who introduces changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.ex: He takes an interest in birds.
words.ex_cn: 他对鸟类感兴趣。
words.en: To become interested in something or someone.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: This factory specializes in making electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专用于制造电动汽车。
words.en: If you specialize in a particular subject or skill, you become an expert in it by focusing your studies or work on it.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: adj. 以实验为基础的；实验性的；
words.ex: The scientist used an experimental method to test the theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一种以实验为基础的方法来检验这个理论。
words.en: Relating to or based on experiment.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr: v. 发芽；长出；迅速成长；涌现；
words.ex: The seed will sprout in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这颗种子会在春天发芽。
words.en: If a plant sprouts, or if it sprouts something, it produces new leaves or buds.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.ex: The country seeks hegemony over its neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家试图对邻国实现霸权。
words.en: Hegemony refers to the dominance or leadership of one group or state over others, especially in a political or cultural context.

words.tr: adj. 工业化的； v. “industrialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The country became industrialized in the 20th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在20世纪实现了工业化。
words.en: An industrialized country or area has a lot of industries and factories.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的方式；以……样的风格；在……程度上
words.ex: He talks in a strange way.
words.ex_cn: 他说话方式很奇怪。
words.en: In the manner of...

words.tr: phrase. 以……的方式；以……的态度；用……的方法
words.ex: He speaks in a quiet way.
words.ex_cn: 他以一种安静的方式说话。
words.en: In a particular manner or style.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: He is sort of tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走了很长的路，有几分累了。
words.en: to some extent; rather

words.ex: The frog hopped over the stone.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跃过了那块石头。
words.en: To move by jumping on one foot or to move quickly and lightly from one place to another.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 迅速登上（交通工具）；快速开始做某事
words.ex: Let's hop on a video call to discuss the project.
words.ex_cn: 让我们加入视频通话来讨论这个项目。
words.en: To quickly board a vehicle or mount something, often implying a lack of formality or haste.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: The city's sprawl has covered many farmlands.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的杂乱无序的拓展覆盖了许多农田。
words.en: If you sprawl somewhere, you sit or lie with your legs and arms spread out in a careless way.

words.ex: People often liken the moon to a silver coin.
words.ex_cn: 人们常把月亮比作一枚银币。
words.en: Compare or equate one thing to another, often to illustrate a similarity.

words.tr: adj. 极其时髦的；非常别致的
words.ex: She wore an ultra-chic outfit to the fashion show.
words.ex_cn: 她在时装秀上穿了一件极其时髦的衣服。
words.en: extremely fashionable and stylish

words.tr: 短语动词. 体验一下；尝到一点（某种经历或感觉的滋味）
words.ex: You should get a taste of the local cuisine when you travel.
words.ex_cn: 旅行时你应该尝试一下当地的菜肴。
words.en: To experience or try something, especially for the first time.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.ex: The project is ongoing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: An ongoing situation has been happening for quite a long time and seems likely to continue for some time in the future.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: The bike is for sale.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车待售。
words.en: If something is for sale, it is being offered to people to buy.

words.tr: adj. 亲自实践的；亲自动手的
words.ex: He likes hands-on learning in science class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在科学课上动手学习。
words.en: Involving or offering active participation rather than theory or observation.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.tr:
n. 车床
v. 用车床加工
words.ex: He uses a lathe to shape wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用车床加工木材。
words.en: A lathe is a machine tool that rotates a workpiece about an axis of rotation to perform various operations such as cutting, sanding, knurling, drilling, or deformation with tools that are applied to the workpiece to create an object with symmetry about that axis.

words.ex: I saw a bird fly over the house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一只鸟飞过房子。
words.en: A saw is a tool consisting of a tough blade, wire, or chain with a hard toothed edge. It is used to cut through material, very often wood, though sometimes metal or stone. The cut is made by placing the toothed edge against the material and moving it forcefully forth and less forcefully back or continuously forward.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.ex: The company fixes problems in its supply chain.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司解决其供应链中的问题。
words.en: A supply chain is a system of organizations, people, activities, information, and resources involved in moving a product or service from supplier to customer.

words.tr: adj. 激光切割的；v. 用激光切割
words.ex: The designer used laser-cut techniques to create intricate patterns.
words.ex_cn: 设计师使用激光切割技术来创造复杂的图案。
words.en: To cut something using a laser, which allows for precise and intricate designs.

words.tr: phrase. 电路板；印刷电路板，用于连接和支持电子元件的板状结构
words.ex: The technician carefully examined the circuit board for any signs of damage.
words.ex_cn: 技术员仔细检查电路板是否有损坏的迹象。
words.en: A circuit board is a thin plate on which chips and other electronic components are placed.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.tr: adj. 高端的；深受老练的、识货的顾客喜爱的
words.ex: The store specializes in high-end fashion.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店专门经营高档时装。
words.en: High-end products or services are of very high quality and are often expensive.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.tr: n. [自] 微分器；微分电路；区分者
words.ex: The differentiator is used to detect rapid changes in the input signal.
words.ex_cn: 微分器用于检测输入信号的快速变化。
words.en: A differentiator is something that makes a person or thing different from others, especially in a way that is considered advantageous.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.ex: Tom often lags behind in class because he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆因为不学习，经常在课堂上落后。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others or to fall behind in progress, development, or achievement.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.tr: adj. 深远的；影响深远的
words.ex: The decision had far-reaching effects on the town.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对这个城镇产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe actions, events, or changes as far-reaching, you mean that they have a very great influence and affect a great number of things.

words.ex: They divide up the food equally among the children.
words.ex_cn: 他们把食物平均分给孩子们。
words.en: To divide something up means to separate it into different parts or areas, usually so that different people can have or use different parts.

words.ex: The company operates in a low-margin industry.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在一个低利润的行业中运营。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by a small difference between the cost of producing something and the price at which it is sold.

words.ex: He wants to invest in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他想投资一家小企业。
words.en: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or achieve a result.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.tr: adj. 富于企业家精神的；企业性质的；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneurial young man who started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个富有企业家精神的年轻人，自己创办了公司。
words.en: Entrepreneurial refers to the characteristics or actions of someone who starts a business and is willing to risk loss in order to make money.

words.tr: 短语. 以……为例；拿……来说
words.ex: Many animals are smart; take dogs for example.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物都很聪明；以狗为例。
words.en: To mention someone or something as an illustration or instance of what is being discussed.

words.ex: A bird built a nest on a small twig.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟在一根小嫩枝上筑了巢。
words.en: A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

words.ex: The speech stoked anger among the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 这篇演讲激起了人群的愤怒。
words.en: To stoke a fire means to add fuel to it to make it burn more strongly. It can also mean to encourage or increase strong feelings or emotions.

words.ex: What on earth are you doing?
words.ex_cn: 你到底在干什么？
words.en: Used for emphasis in questions to express surprise or confusion.

words.ex: The robotic arm helps doctors during surgery.
words.ex_cn: 机械臂帮助医生进行手术。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of robots or robotics.

words.ex: The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。
words.en: A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck and legs and pale brown fur with dark spots. Giraffes are the tallest living land animals.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: There was a spike in sales after the advertisement.
words.ex_cn: 广告发布后，销量出现了激增。
words.en: A spike is a thin, pointed piece of metal, wood, or another hard material, or a sudden increase in something.

words.ex: The system uses voiceprint to identify the user.
words.ex_cn: 该系统使用声纹来识别用户。
words.en: A voiceprint is a graphical representation of someone's voice, showing the characteristics that make it unique, used especially in identifying individuals.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.tr: phrase. 引起对……的注意；使关注
words.ex: He raises his hand to draw attention to his question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手来引起对他的问题的注意。
words.en: To make someone notice or be aware of something.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.tr: n. 因特别精彩而被掌声打断的表演
words.ex: Her performance was a real showstopper, leaving the audience in awe.
words.ex_cn: 她的表演非常精彩，让观众惊叹不已。
words.en: A showstopper is something, especially a performance, that is extremely impressive and popular.

words.ex: The model was a full-sized replica of the original.
words.ex_cn: 这个模型是原物的全尺寸复制品。
words.en: A full-sized object is one that is the normal or usual size, not a smaller or larger version.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.ex: The conference aims to bring together experts from various fields.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议旨在汇集来自不同领域的专家。
words.en: To cause people or things to come together in one place or for a common purpose.

words.ex: The beast ran fast through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 那只野兽在森林里快速奔跑。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.
